string.text: Bayonet

Installing a standard 6x5 bayonet on the weapon allows you to use the rifle as a melee weapon.Due to the design features of the weapon, it is impossible to use a bayonet simultaneously with a silencer.
Wear-resistant USM
Replacing standard trigger parts with high-strength analogues allows you to extend the service life of the weapon and ensure its trouble-free operation in the harsh conditions of the Zone.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Forcing USM
Allows you to significantly increase the rate of fire of weapons.
Replacing the DTK
Replacing the muzzle brake-compensator with a more modern analogue allows you to reduce the felt recoil, which has a beneficial effect on shooting accuracy.
Balanced bolt carrier
Balancing the bolt frame allows you to reduce the weapon moving away from the aiming line during a shot.
High-strength bolt carrier.

Replacing a standard bolt carrier with a similar one made of a high-strength alloy allows you to perform a significantly larger number of firing and reloading cycles of the weapon without the need to service the part.
Lightweight magazine
Replacing a standard metal magazine with a light-alloy counterpart allows you to reduce the overall weight of the weapon.
Modification of the cartridge supply unit
Precise fitting of the parts of the cartridge feeding mechanism allows you to minimize the number of delays associated with the failure to feed a new cartridge after a shot.
Gas outlet modification
The modified gas outlet allows for an increase in the initial velocity of the bullet while reducing recoil.
Lightweight stock
Replacing a standard stock with a lightweight, hollow analogue allows you to reduce the overall weight of the weapon.
Improved backplate
The anatomical rubber butt pad helps soften the felt recoil from a weapon shot.
Lightweight handguard
Allows you to reduce the weight of weapons
Special coating
Applying a protective coating helps slow down the wear of weapon mechanisms.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Cheek pad
Installing a special pad on the butt allows you to reduce the felt recoil of the weapon.
High strength barrel
Replacing the barrel with a high-strength analogue has a beneficial effect on the reliability of the weapon, slowing down the rate of wear from fired shots.
Barrel with rifling pitch 320mm

The standard barrel has a rifling pitch of 240mm, which allows you to fire any type of ammunition (including armor-piercing incendiary), but has a negative impact on the accuracy of fire.Due to the fact that of all the ammunition for SVD in the Zone, only the special sniper version of the cartridges has become widespread, it seems reasonable to replace the barrel with a rifling pitch of 320 mm.Thanks to this replacement, it becomes possible to shoot more accurately when using sniper cartridges.
Barrel adjustment
Increases the initial speed of the bullet and the killing distance.
